result.summary: Found 2 major visual issues: a missing icon in the bottom navigation and a truncated restaurant card at the bottom of the screen, plus a minor content truncation issue.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon; only the text label is visible, making the navigation appear incomplete and inconsistent with the Home, Search, and Profile tabs.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate order history or list icon above the 'Orders' label to match the other bottom navigation items.

issues.description: The restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section (showing a pizza with a -20% badge) is vertically truncated and appears to run into the bottom navigation area, hiding part of the card content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or margin to the scrollable content area so the last card is fully visible above the fixed bottom navigation bar, and verify safe-area inset handling.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of displaying the full name.
issues.suggestion: Increase card width, allow controlled text wrapping, or use an ellipsis with a tooltip to reveal the complete restaurant name.
